env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
[!exec:node] skip 'A-NODE: node is required to run the loader'
cp $GOROOT/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js wasm_exec.js
logos build -o app.wasm .
exists app.wasm
exists app.loader.mjs
exec node check.mjs app.wasm app.loader.mjs
stdout '^reflect-ok$'
-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasmdeadreflect

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"reflect"

	"logos/rt"
)

type Hidden struct {
	v int
}

func (Hidden) Answer() int {
	return 42
}

func hiddenAnswer() int {
	h := Hidden{v: 7}
	t := reflect.TypeOf(h)
	if t.NumMethod() != 1 {
		return -1
	}
	v := reflect.ValueOf(h)
	got := -2
	for i := 0; i < v.NumMethod(); i++ {
		out := v.Method(i).Call(nil)
		if len(out) == 1 && out[0].Kind() == reflect.Int {
			got = int(out[0].Int())
		}
	}
	return got
}

//go:wasmexport checkReflect
func checkReflect() int32 {
	if hiddenAnswer() != 42 {
		return rt.WasmError(errors.New("reflect missed dead method"))
	}
	return rt.WasmError(nil)
}

func main() {
	select {}
}
-- check.mjs --
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
const [wasmPath, loaderPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
const loader = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(loaderPath)).href);
const { exports } = await loader.instantiateLogos(readFileSync(wasmPath), {});
exports.checkReflect();
console.log("reflect-ok");
